answer: A fresh clone is a mirror with nothing behind it: weight on this network comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts a key has sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus. That record forms like a pearl, one honest layer per epoch, and cannot be minted or handed over. When a sybil tide of clones floods in, each must still grade its own way up from zero, so N fakes cost N times the epochs of real judgment labor; the attacker's bill grows linearly in identities with no shortcut.
